userStories.notes: Planning story completed. Generated 11 stories (US-47-002 through US-47-012) covering: match stage contract validation, stale state reference audit, scene_detection module tests, EmbeddingSearch contract tests, match_all_segments integration tests, downloader cache module tests, agent module test coverage, config post_init edge case tests, PipelineState serialization roundtrip tests, stage error propagation tests, and matching metrics edge case tests. Analysis: 13,790 existing tests, but specific gaps in scene_detection (0 tests), downloader caches, agent internals, and match stage contract validation.

userStories.notes: Tier: T3 (hardening). Source files: src/state.py:240-430 (PipelineState), src/checkpoint.py (save/load logic). Existing tests in test_checkpoint_stage_data_roundtrip.py cover stage data but not full PipelineState field coverage. A comprehensive roundtrip test would catch serialization issues (e.g., numpy.float32 not JSON-serializable per Rule 7, Optional fields defaulting incorrectly).

userStories.notes: Tier: T3 (integration). Source files: src/pipeline.py (run method), src/stages/base.py (BaseStage.validate_required_state_attrs), src/checkpoint.py (save/restore). Existing test_stage_error_handling.py covers individual stage error handling but not the cross-stage propagation through the pipeline orchestrator. The user interview identified that stale state references cause AttributeError crashes mid-pipeline - this story ensures such crashes are handled gracefully.
